signals.source_text: The mathematics of his mind began to change, incorporating non-linear dynamics, chaos theory, patterns that followed logical principles yet curved through dimensions of possibility that pure calculation could never access.
Together, they reshaped the cave into something that existed between architecture and organism, a living space that responded to their needs while maintaining its own crystalline identity.

The ice learned to regulate temperature without melting, to provide illumination without external energy sources, to create acoustic properties that allowed them to communicate across vast distances through harmonic resonance.
Torrhen learned mathematical precision from Zephyr, his intuitive magic gaining focus and efficiency through logical framework.
Zephyr learned mystical intuition from Torrhen, his mathematical consciousness gaining flexibility and creativity through magical framework.
